nonvacuity: Compiled scratch/Nonvacuity.lean successfully with /home/ubuntu/sap/tools/sap-lean. It proves, using Mathlib and SAP.P017.Defs without importing Challenge, that under P = gaussianReal 0 1 the measurable estimator h_n(z) = mu + z / sqrt(n) satisfies RootNNormal P h mu with variance witness 1: its scaled error equals z for every n >= 1. Three example declarations construct all T16 hypotheses, taking mu = populationMean G tau, for (G,tau) = (dirac 0, constant 0), the equal mixture of dirac(-1) and dirac(1) with identity effect, and (gaussianReal 0 1, identity effect). These populations have radii 0, 1, and infinity respectively; the radius evaluations follow directly from their means and supports and are not claimed as separate compiled lemmas. The examples establish probability-measure instances, measurability, integrability, and the exact normal limit hypothesis without assuming the conclusion.
